environment.cpuConvention: App process plus its associated WebView renderer; 100 percent = one CPU core; excludes codec service and system compositor.
environment.gpuConvention: System-wide KGSL gpubusy; does not isolate the app and does not measure energy.
environment.frameConvention: HWUI aggregates both app windows; empty histograms normalized to null; counters must not be converted into FPS.
environment.sampleDurations: UI 3 rounds per condition, 20 seconds target; ablation 15 seconds; playback variable, see each measured seconds.
environment.order: UI A/B, B/A, A/B. Navigation: 400 ms per direction, 5 right then 5 left. Warm same-page image caches.
environment.playbackRetestConditions: Initial clean HEVC/HLS and hidden-animation tests used 2D with the phone USB consent dialog present. After the device grant became effective, 2D/SBS matched HEVC AB/BA samples, HLS and UI comparisons were collected without the dialog. These phases are not interchangeable. The same video remained attached through the HEVC mode comparison.
environment.codecResourceCountConvention: Allocated resources include paused/recently stopped players. Initial H.264 4K setup retained a prior paused AVC allocation, so its PSS is not an isolated decoder footprint. Matched HEVC and HLS SBS audits each found one video codec and one HTML video.
environment.sbsConditions: Full-SBS 3840x1080 @ 60 Hz, depth 1, size 95%; child WebView 1920x1080 physical / 1440x810 CSS pixels. HEVC 2D round 1, SBS rounds 1 and 2, 2D round 2; same segment and theme order AB/BA. SBS UI two rounds, matched 2D UI one round afterward.
environment.sustainedLimit: Short benchmark windows; no uninterrupted 10-minute 4K60 thermal endurance test or battery-power measurement.

sbsFrameValidation.scope: Three software display captures during playback; aligned by actual depth 1 / size 95% geometry. Confirms sampled L/R content and motion, not optical comfort, eye order, audio or every-frame synchronization.

home2DSupplement.scope: Auxiliary continuous-rendering evidence; only retained 9.08 seconds analyzed.

2dPlayback.scope: One 20-second simpleUI 4K60 playback trace per mode. Surface frame duration is not frame interval, optical latency or app-only GPU cost. Vendor jank classifications are auxiliary and not translated into a user-visible stutter rate.
